title: TOEIC 每日練習 Day 27（2026-11-24）
summary: 最新成績仍是 Day 15 的 15/25，Day 16 之後還沒收到交卷。今天繼續加強：keep／make／find + 受詞 + 形容詞（含 surprisingly easy 副詞對照），以及閱讀、聽力的「時間與數字干擾」。另外複習 if 子句配 will／would、In spite of／Although、comply with、whose／who、be in charge of、at + 時刻。聽力今天是 Part 3 對話。做完按「交卷」就會自動回傳成績

sections.heading: Part 5 文法與字彙（建議 11 分鐘）
sections.tip: keep／make／find + 受詞 + 空格：描述受詞用形容詞（extremely 後面也是形容詞）；空格後面若還有形容詞，空格就是副詞。假設語氣先看主要子句：will 配 if 現在式，would 配 if 過去式。Although 接句子，In spite of 接名詞。時刻用 at。

qs.stem: If the shipment ------- by Friday, we will send the invoice on Monday.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 will send ＝ 真實可能發生。2. if 子句用現在式，the shipment 單數用 arrives。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: If Mr. Lee ------- more time, he would review every report himself.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 would review ＝ 與現在事實相反（他其實沒時間）。2. if 子句用過去式 had。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: Please keep the emergency exit ------- at all times.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. keep + 受詞（the emergency exit）+ 空格，描述出口的狀態。2. 狀態用形容詞 clear（暢通的）。3. 選 A。

qs.stem: The staff made the new filing system ------- easy to use.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. make + 受詞 + 空格 + easy。2. 空格後已經有形容詞 easy，空格修飾 easy，用副詞 surprisingly。3. 選 B。口訣：空格後還有形容詞 → 副詞；沒有 → 形容詞。

qs.stem: Many visitors found the museum guide extremely -------.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. find + 受詞（the museum guide）+ extremely + 空格。2. extremely 是副詞，後面要接形容詞，而且後面沒有其他形容詞 → informative。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: ------- the rain, the outdoor concert started on schedule.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. the rain 是名詞，沒有動詞。2. 讓步接名詞用介系詞片語 In spite of（＝ Despite）。3. 選 B。Although／Even though 都要接句子。

qs.stem: ------- the printer is old, it still works well.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後有主詞 the printer＋動詞 is，是句子。2. 讓步接句子用 Although。3. 選 C。

qs.stem: Visitors are required to comply ------- all safety rules in the factory.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：comply with ＝ 遵守。看到 comply 直接選 with。

qs.stem: We contacted the supplier ------- products arrived damaged.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後先出現名詞 products，再接動詞 arrived。2. 「那家供應商『的』產品」。3. 選 whose。

qs.stem: Ms. Rivera is in charge ------- the marketing budget.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. be in charge of ＝ 負責。2. 選 B。對照：be responsible for 用 for，別混。

qs.stem: The training session will begin ------- 2:30 P.M.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 時刻用 at；日期、星期用 on；月份、年份用 in。2. 2:30 P.M. 是時刻，選 C。

sections.heading: Part 7 短篇閱讀（建議 9 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先讀題目、圈關鍵字（purpose、open again、Where、offered），再回原文找那一句。注意「開始日」「最後一天」「重新開放日」和教室號碼、電話號碼都是干擾；instead of 前面是新地點。
passage: Riverside Community Center — Gym Floor Repair
The main gym will be closed from Monday, December 7, to Thursday, December 10, while the floor is repaired. The gym normally opens at 6:00 A.M. and will reopen at this time on Friday, December 11.
During the closure, fitness classes will be held in Room 204 instead of the main gym. Members who cannot attend may join any class next month at no extra charge.
For questions, please call the front office at 555-0148.

qs.stem: What is the purpose of the notice?
opts: To explain a temporary gym closure
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 目的題看標題和第一句：Gym Floor Repair、will be closed。2. 暫時關閉 ＝ temporary closure。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: When will the main gym open again?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. will reopen at this time on Friday, December 11；this time ＝ 平常的 6:00 A.M.。2. 選 C。A 是關閉開始日；B 是關閉最後一天；D 用教室號碼 204 混淆，是數字干擾。

qs.stem: Where will fitness classes take place during the repair?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. classes will be held in Room 204 instead of the main gym。2. instead of 前面是新地點，後面是舊地點（陷阱）。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: What is offered to members who miss a class?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. may join any class next month at no extra charge。2. at no extra charge ＝ free（換句話說）。3. 選 B。

sections.heading: Part 2 聽力應答（建議 6 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先聽清楚第一個字（Why don't you／or／Where／Haven't／Who／How often）。建議句不選 Because；A or B 問句和 Wh 問句不選 Yes。重複題目的字或發音相近的字（break／broke、report／port、run）通常是陷阱。

qs.stem: Why don't you take a short break?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Why don't you…? ＝ 建議「你何不……」。2. B 接受建議。3. A 是 Because 陷阱；C 用 break／broke 發音相近陷阱。

qs.stem: Should we meet in the morning or the afternoon?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. A or B 選擇疑問句，先刪 Yes。2. B 選下午。3. C 用 meet／met 字形相近陷阱。

qs.stem: Where can I find the extra paper?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Where 問地點。2. A 回答地點。3. B 用 paper／newspaper 相關字陷阱；C 是 Yes 陷阱又重複 extra。

qs.stem: Haven't you finished the report yet?
opts: No, I need one more hour.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 把 not 拿掉：Have you finished the report?。2. A「還沒，再一小時」。3. B 用 report／port 發音相近陷阱；C 主詞換成 He，答非所問。

qs.stem: Who is giving the presentation tomorrow?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Who 問人。2. B 回答人名。3. A 是 Yes 陷阱又重複 tomorrow；C 回答地點（Where）。

qs.stem: How often does the shuttle bus run?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. How often 問頻率。2. A「每二十分鐘一班」。3. B 重複 run；C 回答價錢（How much）。

sections.heading: Part 3 對話（建議 4 分鐘）
sections.tip: 播放前先讀三題，圈出 Why change、What time、do next。對話會出現原本時間、抵達時間和新時間，選 instead 後面、對方同意的那個。最後一句通常是下一步，注意 reserve ＝ book。
script: W: Hi, Tom. The client from Greenway just called. She can't come to our meeting at ten tomorrow.
M: Oh, really? Did she say why?
W: Her flight was delayed, so she won't arrive until noon. She asked if we could meet at two instead.
M: Two is fine with me. But Conference Room A is booked in the afternoon.
W: Then let's use Room C. I'll reserve it right now and send her an e-mail.

qs.stem: Why does the client want to change the meeting?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 原因題聽女子第二句：Her flight was delayed。2. 選 A。其他選項都沒提到。

qs.stem: What time will the meeting most likely start?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. She asked if we could meet at two instead，男子說 Two is fine。2. 10 點是原本時間；12 點是客戶抵達時間，都是時間干擾。3. 選 C。

qs.stem: What will the woman do next?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 最後一句 I'll reserve it right now。2. reserve ＝ book（換句話說）。3. 選 B。
